paf_definition: PAF = metabolic-attributable burden (rei 104) / total burden for the same site and measure x 100. Risk panels are cause-410 queries re-based to the cause-1059 denominator by fix_paf.py; attributable counts are identical under either denominator.
paf_ui_method: paf_low/high = paf_point x (attributable_low/high / attributable_point); total-site UI treated as negligible; bounds re-ordered after scaling.

paf_over_100_check.statement: PAFs cannot exceed 100% here; they exceed 100% only if the attributable definition overlaps/aggregates beyond the site denominator. No such case occurs in this table.

sub_risk_caveat: rei 105 (FPG) and 108 (BMI) are sub-risks of rei 104 and are not mutually exclusive; a few negative site-level ensemble estimates yield negative PAFs and must not be summed.
